basic_info.description: Edwardian-style condo at 358 Pierce St #2. This unique layout blends classic elements like a brick fireplace mantel and crown molding with modern conveniences. The eat-in kitchen, with ample pantry space, caters to culinary enthusiasts, complemented by a luxurious clawfoot bathtub and stone sink in the main bathroom. Large light-filled rooms with tall ceilings and tranquil garden views from the back bedrooms. Benefit from two (2) deeded storage spaces and one(1)tandem garage parking spot.    Situated between Hayes Valley and Lower Haight, this vibrant neighborhood offers culture and convenience. Explore streets filled with boutique shops, art galleries, and cozy cafes. Perfect for outdoor lovers, with nearby Duboce, Buena Vista parks, and Alamo Square. Excellent public transportation, bike routes, and Tech bus stops ensure easy city access. Discover a rich array of entertainment venues and eateries, ideal for foodies and night owls. The community's artistic spirit shines through local small businesses. This historic yet convenient home is your perfect San Francisco retreat.
